name: ListResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The code of the cloud service.

You can obtain the code from the Cloud Service Code column in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94479.html
parameters.help_zh:
云服务代码。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94479.html的**云服务代码**列获取
parameters.name: service

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

You can obtain the resource type from the Resource Type column in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94479.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94479.html的**资源类型**列获取
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the total number of resources. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: Queries the total number of resources and returns the result in the TotalCount parameter.
false: Does not query the total number of resources. The TotalCount parameter returns -1, and the resources are still paginated based on the PageNumber and PageSize parameters
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询资源总数。默认值：true。取值：true，查询并通过 TotalCount 返回资源总数；false，不查询资源总数，TotalCount 返回 -1，资源列表仍按 PageNumber 和 PageSize 分页返回
parameters.name: count
